title: Yellow Spicy Syrian Salmon Pilaf
description: A fresh and spicy Syrian dish featuring hot smoked flaked salmon, perfect for a hangover cure or a flavorful meal. This buddhist-temple-friendly recipe is made with smoke-hot spices and springy herbs.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground aleppo pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed and drained basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in the spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Flake the hot smoked salmon into the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Squeeze the freshly squeezed lemon juice over the top of the pilaf and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
